Allura Zamarripa (born August 15, 2002) is an American tennis player. Career [ edit ] She has a career-high WTA doubles ranking of 225, achieved on October 24, 2022. Up to date, she has won one singles title and nine doubles titles on the ITF Circuit . Zamarripa won her biggest title to date at the 2020 Bellatorum Resources Pro Classic in the doubles event, partnering with her twin sister Maribella , defeating Paula Kania-Choduń and Katarzyna Piter in the final.
